tuto.goal: In Quadri Kids, all players place <bold>Color Tiles</bold> in a <bold>shared play area</bold> to recreate the shapes of their <bold>Objective cards</bold>.
tuto.piles:
Here are the 4 piles of Color Tiles: <bold>12 tiles</bold> of each color at the start.
The number in the top left corner shows how many are left.
tuto.objectives:
Here are your <bold>2 Objective cards</bold>. Each one shows a shape of 3 squares to complete with Color Tiles.
It is worth <bold>3 points</bold> at the end of the game.
tuto.help: <italic>At any time, click on a game element to learn what it does.</italic>
tuto.place:
On your turn, you draw one Color Tile from any pile and place it:
- <bold>edge to edge</bold> (not diagonally) with an existing tile,
- or <bold>on top of</bold> a tile.
tuto.first-objective: Look at your yellow-black-yellow card: only <bold>one yellow tile</bold> is missing under the black tile!
tuto.lay-yellow: Click the <bold>yellow pile</bold>, then the space under the black tile.
tuto.completed:
Well done, you completed your first objective!
The card is placed <bold>face up in front of you</bold>, and you draw a new one, keeping 2 in hand at all times.
tuto.anytime:
A completed objective is validated <bold>at any moment</bold>, even during another player’s turn.
Beware: a tile placed by Antoine can complete one of your objectives!
tuto.second-objective:
Look at your yellow-magenta-yellow card.
The 2 yellow tiles are already there, but a <bold>cyan tile</bold> is where the magenta should be.
tuto.lay-magenta:
You can place a tile <bold>on top of</bold> another one, with no limit to the number of layers: only the top tile counts.
Place a <bold>magenta tile</bold> on the cyan tile.
tuto.orientation:
Another objective!
A shape can be completed <bold>as shown on the card</bold>, <bold>mirrored</bold>, or <bold>rotated</bold>.
tuto.end:
The game ends when <bold>one pile of Color Tiles is depleted</bold>: the active player then ends their turn.
The game also ends immediately if all objectives have been completed.
tuto.winner: The player with <bold>the most points</bold> wins.
tuto.cooperative:
There is also a <bold>cooperative variant</bold>, for one or more players: together, complete 15 to 30 objectives before a Color Tile pile runs out.
Choose it in the options when you create a game.
tuto.go: Now finish the game against Antoine. Good luck!
